therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: appetite stimulation and weight gain in cancer cachexia
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adult patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer and malignancy-associated weight loss and anorexia
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: mean change from baseline in body weight and 5-item Anorexia Symptom Subscale over 12 weeks

results.effect_size: Body weight: mean difference 1.284 kg (95% CI: 0.718-1.851); 5-IASS: mean difference 0.141 points (95% CI: -0.641-0.923)
results.dose_information: 100 mg anamorelin HCl administered as tablets in fasted condition
